summary: Implemented all seven plan phases: a repo-scoped .gate-lock bounded-wait, fail-open mutex added to task-lock.sh, wired into tests/run-all.sh's top level and verify-deploy.sh's Gate 8, with a 15-case fixture suite proving serialization, non-vacuousness, stale-holder reclaim, nested invocation, fail-open, and verdict identity against the real mechanism. A genuine integration defect (VERIFY_DEPLOY_NESTED read before its own unconditional export inside gate8_run()) was found and fixed live. The contract is documented in batch-orchestration-guardrails.md. The deploy was regenerated and confirmed byte-identical to the source store, and the complete gate set passed 37/38 against the explicit source-store target, with the sole deviation fully attributed to evidence (a foreign, out-of-scope uncommitted mutation in a file this task never touched, since reverted and redeployed by someone else, plus the dispatch's own enumerated known-unrelated baseline). Two earlier-phase files were caught uncommitted by a commit-containment-check artifact and recovered before closeout.
